systems.owner: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation

MUS.note: The register names CERT-Mu as ISO 27001 certified but does not say it was created by law, decree or order, nor any incident handled.

systems.system: Mauritius Telecom data centres (Rose Belle, Rose Hill)

MUS.note: Emtel and Mauritius Telecom data centres are named as ISO 27001 certified; the register does not say they rent to others or give a Tier.

facts.fact: The Mauritius Standards Bureau's register as at 30 June 2026 lists 11 organisations certified to MS ISO/IEC 27001:2022, an information security standard held as a Mauritian national standard.
facts.system: MS ISO/IEC 27001:2022 under the MSB National ISMS Certification Scheme

MUS.note: Ownership, hire and hosting of government data are not stated for the listed data centres.

facts.fact: The Mauritius Standards Bureau runs a National Information Security Management System Certification Scheme against MS ISO/IEC 27001:2022, an information security standard it treats as a national standard.
facts.system: MS ISO/IEC 27001:2022 under the MSB National ISMS Certification Scheme

facts.fact: The register lists 11 certified organisations as at 30 June 2026, including the Passport and Immigration Office (certificate issued 30 October 2025), CERT-Mu, the Mauritius Revenue Authority, the Police IT Unit and the National Sanctions Secretariat, with accredited certificates.
